What it does

Grammarly's value for a trade business is unglamorous but real: quotes, emails and proposals that read professionally and contain no typos. It works directly in the browser and in email, so it catches mistakes at the point of writing. The free tier handles spelling and grammar; paid tiers push style suggestions fairly aggressively.

Where the AI actually is

AI grammar, tone and clarity suggestions as you write.

Pros

  • Fixes typos in quotes before customers see them
  • Works in the browser and in email
  • Free tier handles the basics

Cons

  • Premium pricing pushes hard for upgrades

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Remodelers & carpenters, Landscapers in mind. Making customer-facing documents look professional.
